dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: Oh! It's you. We've met before, at Dreambow Drift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing on Tete Isle?

dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: They're in need of manpower here. Building this Dance-Off Stage took a lot of work.

dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: I daresay it'd be hard to find something like this anywhere else in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: See those glowing signboards and lights? Our luminescent graffiti alone can't manage that. Apparently, it was accomplished using some materials transported from Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: I hear it was a caravan from the Voynich Guild. Pretty outlandish name, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Oquichi
dialogues.text: Once I get some time off, I plan on going to Nod-Krai and seeing what it's like.
